_model_note: Install script auto-selects based on RAM: 24GB+ -> filemaid-gemma4-26b, 16GB+ -> filemaid-gemma4-12b, else filemaid-metadata. Model is the fallback; image_model handles image files; text_model handles non-image files.
_project_markers_note: Directories that identify a project root. When scanning with --depth, encountering one of these markers stops recursion and treats the containing directory as a project candidate. User values are additive with the built-in defaults.
_rename_note: Set rename=true to let the LLM suggest better filenames. rename_level (0-5) is the minimum quality threshold a suggested new name must meet before filemaid applies it. 1 = most aggressive (even weak suggestions), 2 = aggressive, 3 = moderate, 4 = conservative, 5 = most conservative (only excellent suggestions). 0 accepts any suggestion. Invalid characters are removed, extensions are preserved, and collisions get a counter suffix.
_ffmpeg_note: rename_use_ffmpeg enables audio/video fingerprinting via ffmpeg. This improves duplicate/near-duplicate detection but can be slow for large media libraries. Install ffmpeg with 'brew install ffmpeg' and ensure it is on PATH.
